how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps from request to confirmed group booking.
how.step1Body: Describe your group, destination, dates, board and budget. One form replaces dozens of emails.
how.step2Body: Approved hotels in your destination submit quotations within hours, not days.
how.step3Body: Side-by-side quote comparison, in-platform messaging, then a confirmed booking with a clear contract.

about.title: About GroupToStay
about.body: GroupToStay is a B2B marketplace built exclusively for group accommodation. We connect operators who book at scale with hotels that specialize in serving them. Our mission is to remove the friction from group hotel sourcing — replacing dozens of emails and phone calls with a single, transparent workflow.
